practice.text: The Birch Road dog park reopens Saturday, April 4, with new fencing and a separate small-dog area.

image.alt: Trees beside a quiet town park path

factSheet.title: Birch Road Dog Park Reopening
factSheet.body: The Birch Road dog park reopens Saturday, April 4, after fencing repairs. A separate small-dog area has been added.

practice.staticExplanation: Checked: the reopening date matches the parks department notice.

factors.label: Source
factors.detail: The post comes from the parks department's verified account.

factors.label: Claim vs record
factors.displayValue: Post: reopens April 4 · Record: reopens April 4
factors.detail: The April 4 date matches the parks notice.

factors.label: Wording
factors.detail: The post states the details plainly.

practice.counterfactualExplanation: This would be labeled misleading if the parks notice gave a different reopening date.

posts.text: Our 2025 numbers are in: Riverton's recycling rate rose to 41%, up from 36% the year before. Thanks for sorting, everyone.

image.alt: Trees beside a quiet town park path

factSheet.title: 2025 Waste Diversion Summary
factSheet.body: Riverton's residential recycling rate for 2025 was 41%, up from 36% in 2024.

posts.staticExplanation: Checked: this matches the city's published 2025 recycling figures.

factors.label: Source
factors.detail: The post comes from the city's verified recycling account.

factors.label: Claim vs record
factors.detail: The 41% figure matches the 2025 waste summary exactly.

factors.label: Wording
factors.detail: The post states the figure plainly, without hype.

posts.counterfactualExplanation: This would be labeled misleading if the rate differed from the city's 2025 summary.

posts.text: Heads up: starting in May, the Riverton library will be closed every Monday. Plan your returns for other days.

factSheet.title: Riverton Public Library Hours from May 1
factSheet.body: Starting May 1, the library is closed on Sundays only. It stays open Monday through Saturday, 9 am to 7 pm.

factors.displayValue: Post: closed every Monday · Record: closed Sundays only; open Mondays

posts.text: Shocking: Riverton had air-quality alerts on 30 days last summer. That's a full month of bad air!

posts.text: Good news: Riverton tap water met all 12 safety limits in March.
